digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (G7 criteria routing and impact grading)
propositions: G7 routing must change from (block_threshold 0.95, default_posture 'advisory') to (block_threshold 0.85, default_posture 'blocking') to enable blocking at verified >=0.85 priority with zero false-positive findings across 348 historical G7 findings.

Plan-review blocking at G7 0.85 must admit both floor-grade kinds (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site) via existing divergence impact grading; incomplete_enumeration cannot reach 0.85 priority via the divergence axis and stays advisory.

G7 rubric must add four rules: fail-open abstain on unresolvable parent, closed-parent final-state checking with sibling-handoff non-violation, one finding per contradicted parent clause (dedup-at-source), and floor-kind guidance distinguishing contract contradictions from cosmetic mismatches.

Pinned blocking-set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking'); new G7_BLOCKING constant added to set-union expression in the blocking-set test.

Real pass-review Pass-3 wrapper with real impact_plan must confirm contradicts_reality and omits_required_site findings block at high validity, incomplete_enumeration stays advisory, and boundary case at priority exactly 0.85 blocks.
